When you say “catheter drainage failure,” what kind of catheter is it (urinary Foley/suprapubic, nephrostomy, peritoneal drain, dialysis catheter, etc.), and what was it placed for?

Also: when did the severe lower abdominal pain and shortness of breath start (sudden vs gradual), and do you have any fever/chills or inability to pass urine/gas?

message.content:
It's an indwelling pouch catheter that was placed for continuous drainage of my MAINZ pouch urinary diversion. I had this catheter because I have a continent urinary diversion after my radical cystectomy for bladder cancer.

The severe lower abdominal pain and shortness of breath started after the catheter drainage failed, which was the night before I came to the hospital. I'm not sure if it was sudden or gradual - it just got worse after the drainage stopped working.

I don't have a fever or chills, and I'm not sure about passing urine or gas since the catheter was supposed to handle the drainage.
